question: T12 (task-9ef25b7ce856f765): on the desktop, Home, End, PageDown and PageUp on Wave Intensity, which move it by several steps or one: the value, which blocks follow the foot (a Text block above the old foot), the rows, Undo and Redo. On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and two Text blocks added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26, 1/2/3/10, 1/2/3/10); 'place i r0/c0/r1/c1' moves and resizes block i by hand. Every plan places the second Text block at 8/2/10/10, then selects the Scrolling block, Edit, Design ('open'), and presses Wave Intensity (180: the range's end). Then, through one DevTools session, a press on the range's thumb at the value it shows (no change), one real key, and reads of the value, the focus and Undo and Redo 60 ms and 1200 ms after it ('keys'); then a read, Escape and a press on the page ('go'), and Cmd+Z until as built. M1: 180, Home; M2: 90, End; M3: 180, PageDown; M4: 90, PageUp. R1 and R2 are two sessions (probe-w.mjs in the lane folder), each with plans of other tasks. Exit without saving each time.
readsAre: As CAP-T12DRAGFALL: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t: the page's clock, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus (isRange: the range has it), Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines }]) and its events by the page's clock from the first (log: type, ms, the range's value). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z, skipped when the section is back as built).
answer: Each key moves the value at once (60 ms after it) and the blocks as a press on that value does; the range keeps the focus, Undo on, Redo off.

M1, Home from 180 (1/2/7/26, the Text blocks at 5/2/7/10 and 12/2/14/10): 0, the Scrolling block 1/2/2/26, the first Text block on the foot at 2/2/4/10 and the second 3 rows up to 9/2/11/10, 10 rows, as the press fall to 0 (CAP-T12DRAGJUMP JG).

M3, PageDown from 180: 150, one step; 1/2/6/26, the first Text block stays at 5/2/7/10 (it starts on or above the new foot), the second goes up by the foot's row to 11/2/13/10, 12 rows (as CAP-T12TOPFALL P).

M4, PageUp from 90: 120, one step; 1/2/5/26 stays, and so do the Text blocks (3/2/5/10, 10/2/12/10), 11 rows. Its Cmd+Z takes back the step with no change in the areas (Undo still on, Redo on), then the press on 90.
Escape keeps every area; the key is one undo step. R1 and R2 read alike in every read (areas, rows, line, Undo and Redo, the value and the focus).
Not read: PageUp or PageDown at the range's ends, the phone view, a key with a modifier, a key held down.
